links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of deployed ICU model on forward-in-time temporal validation cohort
links.effect: AUROC 0.856 to 0.960 and AUPRC 0.302 to 0.786 across six tasks; good overall calibration, with lower discrimination and worse calibration for intubation and slight hospital mortality overestimation at high probabilities.
links.quote: A continuously deployed, EMR-integrated ICU prediction system achieved strong temporal discrimination and generally good calibration.

unlisted_practices: EMR-embedded patient- and unit-level visualization of hourly predictions without prescriptive alerts
automated hourly model updates for continuous deployment
landmark (24-hour) sensitivity analysis to check robustness beyond repeated-measures evaluation

screen.reason: Evaluates the prospective operational deployment and temporal validation of an EMR-integrated ICU predictive system, but does not compare outcomes with vs without a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
